description: Use Git bisect to find which commit broke Visa card validation in the payment-service repository. The repository is at /home/ga/workspace/payment-service/. A test script ./run_test.sh is provided that exits 0 for good commits and 1 for bad commits. Tag v2.3.0-release is known good (Visa validation works), tag v2.4.0-current at HEAD is known bad (Visa validation fails). Steps: (1) Open terminal in VSCode, (2) cd to /home/ga/workspace/payment-service/, (3) Run 'git bisect start', (4) Run 'git bisect bad v2.4.0-current', (5) Run 'git bisect good v2.3.0-release', (6) For each commit Git checks out, run './run_test.sh' and mark as good or bad with 'git bisect good' or 'git bisect bad', (7) Once Git identifies the culprit commit, save the log with 'git bisect log > /home/ga/workspace/bisect_result.txt', (8) End with 'git bisect reset'. The bisect will find the commit that introduced the bug.
